summary: Frontend-only E2E testing of the 4 new flows (French UI) via the public preview URL with Playwright: (1) Catalogue quincaillerie tab — exchange rate save + paste import preview/commit/search/delete; (2) Quotes → Adams Rite drawings modal (search, check, save, persistence, reset); (3) Jobs board desktop — create job, link a real quote via picker, click 'ouvrir ↗' (PDF blob + new tab), delete; (4) Jobs mobile 390x844 — compact stacked list grouped by stage with row tap + prev/next stage buttons. ALL 4 flows PASSED. All test data was cleaned up (catalog back to 294 items, quote drawing_pages empty, no ZZ-TEST jobs).

issues: 'VOIR LE SITE' link wraps onto 3 lines and crowds the top bar; 'GESTION' / 'VOIR LE SITE' / 'DÉCONNEXION' compete for width. Consider hiding 'Voir le site' on mobile or using icon-only.

The ◀ / ▶ stage buttons are stacked vertically at the right edge (▶ above, disabled ◀ below) instead of a horizontal ◀▶ pair; the disabled ◀ at 20% opacity is nearly invisible and the pair overlaps the row's bottom line.
Native browser date input used for 'Échéance' (renders mm/dd/yyyy US format inside a French/CAD UI) instead of a shadcn calendar or a fr-CA formatted control.

Linked quote is labelled 'Soumission · 0001' and the picker shows '0001 · Ministère de la Justice' — docNum() drops the SO- prefix used everywhere else (quote modal title says SO-0001). Cosmetic inconsistency.

action_items: Cosmetic only: prefix quote numbers with SO- in the jobs document picker/linked list (docNum in JobsPanel.jsx).
Cosmetic only: lay out the mobile ◀▶ stage buttons horizontally and raise the disabled-state opacity.
Optional: replace the native date input in JobsPanel modals with the shadcn calendar / fr-CA format.
critical_code_review_comments: CatalogPanel flash() clears the notice after 3.5s — acceptable UX, but automated tests must assert it within that window (caused one false negative in my first run).

AuthContext uses sessionStorage Bearer token with withCredentials:false; on a fresh page the first /api/auth/me returns 401 (expected, logged as console error). Occasionally the very first login submit produced no /auth/login request in automation — a retry loop was needed. Worth verifying the submit handler isn't gated on an unsettled state (potential double-submit/no-submit race on slow hydration).
JobsPanel.jsx is 509 lines and holds the board + detail modal; splitting JobDetail into its own file would help maintainability.
seed_data_creation: Temporary only, all deleted: catalog items ZZ-TEST-1 / ZZ-TEST-2, jobs JOB-0008 'ZZ-TEST job QA' and JOB-0009 'ZZ-TEST mobile job', quote SO-0001 drawing_pages set to [24] then reset to empty. USD→CAD rate left at 1.40 as requested.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login helper: fill [data-testid=admin-login-username]/[admin-login-password], click [data-testid=admin-login-submit], then poll sessionStorage key 'portech_access_token' and retry the click up to 3x (first click occasionally doesn't fire the request). Verified values: import 100 USD @1.40 -> cost 140,00 $ / sell 182,00 $; 250,33 -> 350,46 $ / 455,60 $; drawings index returns 39 entries, '3600 Series Concealed Vertical Rod' = quote-drawing-24; only ONE quote exists (SO-0001, Ministère de la Justice); jobs list is empty by default so create a job before testing the mobile list. Never delete the 294 Adams Rite catalog items (guard your delete loop by asserting 'ZZ-TEST' is in the row text — window.confirm must be auto-accepted and the DELETE response awaited).
rca_of_the_issue: No product defects found. Two test-harness pitfalls: (a) catalog success notice auto-hides after 3.5s; (b) an unfiltered catalog table plus an auto-accepting dialog handler can delete real items — always filter by search + assert row text before clicking catalog-del-*.
